metadata.description: Game development skills for AI agents — design, engineering, narrative, infrastructure, and React animations — plus Claude Code mods

plugins.name: game-dev
plugins.description: Complete game development plugin — 25 skills, 7 commands, 3 agents, 5 hooks. Genre-agnostic patterns for any game type.

plugins.name: game-dev-design
plugins.description: Game design skills — core loops, economy, levels, procedural generation, quests, skill trees, and UI/UX patterns.

plugins.name: game-dev-engineering
plugins.description: Game engineering skills — backend architecture, state sync, auth, payments, analytics, matchmaking, Redis, BullMQ, and audio.

plugins.name: game-dev-narrative
plugins.description: Game narrative skills — character design, quest coherence, worldbuilding, and story structure for interactive games.

plugins.name: game-dev-infrastructure
plugins.description: Game infrastructure skills — CI/CD pipelines, Claude Code workflows, Cursor integration, and monitoring/ops.

plugins.name: game-dev-commands
plugins.description: Game development workflow commands as skills — architect, build, review, balance, expand, quest, and lore generation.

plugins.name: standalone-skills
plugins.description: Standalone skills — React animations and OpenClaw Genie.

plugins.name: commit-guard
plugins.description: Blocks commits that carry absolute paths from this machine, git add -A / git add ., and pushes straight to main or master.

plugins.name: prod-guard
plugins.description: Holds every write call to the Dokploy MCP server (deploy, save, update, delete, stop...) until you press Proceed. Reads pass through.

plugins.name: bun-only
plugins.description: Rewrites npm, npx, yarn and pnpm commands to bun and bunx before they run, and bunx biome to bun run lint:biome.

plugins.name: done-gate
plugins.description: A band above the prompt listing the files this turn edited and the checks still owed: format, lint, typecheck, tests.

plugins.name: worktrees
plugins.description: A band above the prompt with the git worktrees of the current repo: branch, uncommitted changes, and the count against a limit of 10.

plugins.name: usage-rings
plugins.description: Context, 5h and 7d usage above the prompt, each ring coloured by level: green, yellow, orange, red.

plugins.name: pino-guard
plugins.description: Blocks edits that add a pino transport (pino.transport() or a transport target) without a development-only guard: under bun build its worker thread cannot load inlined modules and every log stream dies silently.

plugins.name: sql-guard
plugins.description: Holds psql commands that write (INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE, DROP, TRUNCATE, ALTER...) or run a SQL file, and drizzle-kit push/migrate, until you press Proceed, unless the database is local.

plugins.name: pr-status
plugins.description: A band above the prompt with the pull request of the current branch: CI checks passed, failed and running, and the review decision. Reads gh, refreshes every minute and after each turn.
